tagline: Chiangjiang取景器相机，1959 年发布
description: The Chiangjiang (长江 - 'long river' - the Chinese name for the Yangtse river) and the Huashan (華山 - Mount Hua - a mountain in Shaanxi Province) are two Chinese copies of the Soviet Smena 1 35mm viewfinder camera, apparently made with Soviet cooperation in about 1959-61.
